_om: Mystic: what the fortune teller says. hoyere/lavere: the hint after the first guess. forste/andre: right on the first or second try. bom: wrong twice.
hoyere: Look up – the card is higher.
The card is higher than you think.
lavere: Look down – the card is lower.
The card is lower than you think.
forste: Spot on! You must be psychic.
You saw it before I did!
First try! Are you the mystic now?
The cards have no secrets from you.
It was written in the stars!
andre: The ball gave you a nudge.
A bit misty, but you saw it!
Got it on the second try!
The stars showed you the way.
bom: The stars were out of line.
